description: Dependency-free normalization for the narrow CSS color surface used by Notion content.

members.name: TryNormalizeColor
members.description: Validates and normalizes one literal CSS color. Functions with external state, declarations, custom properties, quotes and statement separators are rejected.

members.name: TryNormalizeColorStyle
members.description: Normalizes a style containing only color and background-color declarations with literal color values.
